one_liner: Salesforce has a broad REST/SOAP/Bulk API with OAuth2 and a free Developer Edition org; the vendor also offers hosted MCP servers.
auth_notes: OAuth 2.0 via connected apps / external client apps (authorization code, client credentials, JWT bearer). SOAP login() uses username+password+security token (session ID). JWT is minted by the developer.
access_notes: Free Developer Edition org has API access enabled; trial orgs are not API-enabled. Production API requires Enterprise+ or add-on, but that is the customer's cost. Legal terms say apps may need AppExchange Partner Program enrollment, with exceptions.
blocker_notes: A free Developer Edition org gives working API and OAuth credentials self-serve. The AppExchange Partner Program requirement for distributed apps is a possible ToS concern, but the evidence has exceptions and it is unverified.

evidence.quote: it must be authorized as a safe visitor. To implement this authorization, use either an external client app or a connected app and an OAuth 2.0 authorization flow.
When a client app invokes the `login()` call, it passes in a username and password as credentials.
API access is enabled by default in Enterprise, Performance, Unlimited, and Developer Edition orgs.
Developer Edition provides a free and easy solution so that you can use Salesforce for testing and development.
Salesforce provides a [comprehensive set of APIs](https://developer.salesforce.com/developer-centers/integration-apis) that address a wide range of use cases.
Salesforce Hosted MCP Servers give AI agents a secure, governed way to interact with Salesforce data and automation.
The Salesforce DX MCP Server is a specialized Model Context Protocol (MCP) implementation designed to facilitate seamless interaction between large language models (LLMs) and Salesforce orgs.
